reviews.text: I went here for a leash about 6 months ago and left crying and traumatized. Not a single bird had food, water,  much less toys. The African gray by the front door had a nostril the size of a marble. I wanted so badly to take that bird home and get it to a vet. I WOULD take it and care for it properly if they were willing to surrender it for its own good. I haven't been able to stop thinking about it since and wish I could do something to help those birds. Don't support these kinds of stores. Their animals are suffering. My heart is completely broken for that bird even 6 months later. I asked the staff why none of their birds had food, water or toys and they said they were cleaning. Sure. 😭

I visited this pet shop to get supplies for my new kitten, and I was honestly overwhelmed at first because I didn’t know what brands to trust. I also noticed one toy I picked had a loose thread, and they replaced it immediately without any back-and-forth. Overall, it felt like a supportive place for beginners like me.
